# B2 Reference Architectures for Robotics

> Reference architectures, third-party integrations, and B2 sample applications for robot log offload, fleet search and replay, teleoperation datasets, simulation rollouts, policy training and release, and mapping archives with Backblaze B2.

Canonical Backblaze product documentation: https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-ai-machine-learning. Use this index to select an architecture, integration configuration, or sample application.

## Start here

- [Robotics summary](docs/robotics.md): Concise workload, B2 fit, capabilities, and boundaries.
- [Architecture index](docs/architecture-index.md): Human-readable index generated from the catalog.
- [Machine-readable catalog](catalog/architectures.yaml): Audiences, workflows, capabilities, integrations, security, and compliance.
- [Full text](llms-full.txt): Summary and every architecture in one file.

## Architectures

- [Offload robot logs from the fleet into a raw log lake](architectures/robot-log-offload/architecture.md): Robots record split rosbag2/MCAP files locally; an offload agent uploads each closed split to B2 over intermittent links, deletes the local copy only after the stored version's size and SHA-256 match the closed split, catalogs each session in Parquet, and copies incident windows into a separate Object Lock evidence bucket.
- [Search, visualize and replay fleet sessions from the log lake](architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md): Engineers query the session catalog in place to find sessions by robot, date, topic, or event, then open the matching MCAP or RRD files in browser viewers over presigned range reads, or download splits by presigned GET and replay them locally with ros2 bag play.
- [Record teleoperation demonstrations and stream imitation-learning datasets](architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md): Teleop episodes are written in the LeRobot v3 layout or as Zarr replay buffers under versioned dataset prefixes on B2, curated in place, frozen as immutable versions, and streamed to trainers with ranged GETs instead of full downloads.
- [Generate simulation rollouts and synthetic demonstrations at scale](architectures/sim-rollout-datasets/architecture.md): Parallel simulation workers load shared USD and MJCF assets from B2 and write each completed episode (video, state/action/reward arrays, summary JSON) to an append-only run prefix used for behavioral cloning, offline RL, and evaluation baselines.
- [Train and evaluate robot policies, checkpoint runs, and release models to the fleet](architectures/policy-training-registry/architecture.md): Distributed visuomotor and VLA policy training streams data from B2 and writes checkpoints for fault-tolerant resume; runs and eval artifacts are tracked with lineage to dataset versions, and promoted policies are copied to a locked release prefix that robots and CI pull by presigned GET.
- [Archive LiDAR mapping sessions and publish site maps to robots](architectures/mapping-session-archive/architecture.md): LiDAR scans from mobile robots are archived per session; odometry and point-cloud jobs write poses, map snapshots, and trajectories beside the raw scans, and approved site maps are promoted to versioned prefixes that robots and RViz pull by presigned GET.

## Third-party integrations

- [ROS 2 rosbag2](https://github.com/ros2/rosbag2): S3 sync tool. Record bounded MCAP splits locally (`ros2 bag record -s mcap -d <seconds>`); an offload agent presigned-PUTs each closed split to `bags/<robot>/<session>/` and HEAD-confirms it before deleting the local copy (Rosbag2 Cloud Offload sample), and depots move bulk sessions with `rclone move` to the same prefix ([setup guide](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/rosbag2-cloud-offload/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)). Architectures: architectures/robot-log-offload/architecture.md
- [rclone](https://rclone.org/b2/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Native B2 backend with chunked large-file upload (--b2-chunk-size, --b2-upload-concurrency). Architectures: architectures/robot-log-offload/architecture.md, architectures/sim-rollout-datasets/architecture.md
- [DuckDB (httpfs)](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/core_extensions/httpfs/s3api.html): S3 custom endpoint. `CREATE SECRET (TYPE s3, ENDPOINT 's3.<region>.backblazeb2.com', REGION '<region>')`, then query `s3://` paths. Architectures: architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md
- [Foxglove app (remote files)](https://docs.foxglove.dev/docs/visualization/connecting/cloud-data): Presigned URLs. Opens a presigned GET URL to the B2 object directly (no redirects); requires range requests and bucket CORS for the Foxglove origins. Architectures: architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md
- [Foxglove Primary Site (self-managed)](https://docs.foxglove.dev/docs/primary-sites/installation): S3 custom endpoint. Set Helm storageProvider s3_compatible and S3_COMPATIBLE_SERVICE_URL to `https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com` for the inbox and lake buckets; configure a B2 Event Notification rule on the inbox and a small adapter that verifies the B2 webhook signature and POSTs to the Primary Site bucket-notifications endpoint ([setup guide](https://docs.foxglove.dev/docs/primary-sites/configure-cloud-credentials)). Architectures: architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md
- [Rerun Web Viewer](https://rerun.io/docs): Presigned URLs. Pass a presigned GET URL for the .rrd to WebViewer.start(), and add the viewer origin to the bucket CORS rules ([setup guide](https://ref.rerun.io/docs/js/0.37.0/web-viewer/classes/WebViewer.html)). Architectures: architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md
- [Hugging Face LeRobot](https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot): S3 sync tool. LeRobot records and loads v3 datasets from a local root; sync the finalized dataset directory to `datasets/<name>/<version>/` with rclone or s5cmd and back to each trainer's local root, or stream ranged GETs straight from B2 with the LeRobot B2 Streaming sample ([setup guide](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lerobot-b2-streaming/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)). Architectures: architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md
- [Daft (LeRobot reader)](https://docs.daft.ai/en/stable/datasets/lerobot/): S3 custom endpoint. `daft.datasets.lerobot.read('s3://...', io_config=IOConfig(s3=S3Config(endpoint_url='https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com')))` ([setup guide](https://docs.daft.ai/en/stable/api/config/)). Architectures: architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md
- [Zarr (via s3fs)](https://zarr.dev/): fsspec / s3fs. FsspecStore over `s3fs.S3FileSystem(endpoint_url='https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com')` ([setup guide](https://s3fs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)). Architectures: architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md
- [DVC](https://dvc.org/): S3 custom endpoint. `dvc remote modify <name> endpointurl https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com` ([setup guide](https://doc.dvc.org/user-guide/data-management/remote-storage/amazon-s3)). Architectures: architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md
- [MuJoCo Playground](https://playground.mujoco.org/): S3 sync tool. Write each finished episode (MP4, .npy state/action/reward arrays, summary JSON) to a local run directory, then sync closed episodes to `rollouts/<env>/<policy>/<run_id>/` with rclone or s5cmd; the MuJoCo Rollout Dataset sample writes the same layout directly with boto3 ([setup guide](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/mujoco-rollout-dataset/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)). Architectures: architectures/sim-rollout-datasets/architecture.md
- [NVIDIA Isaac Sim (asset region profiles)](https://developer.nvidia.com/isaac/sim): S3 custom endpoint. Define an isaacsim.storage.native asset_region_profiles entry with endpoint `https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`, bucket, and region, and select it with ISAACSIM_ASSET_REGION_PROFILE ([setup guide](https://docs.isaacsim.omniverse.nvidia.com/6.1.0/py/source/extensions/isaacsim.storage.native/docs/SETTINGS.html)). Architectures: architectures/sim-rollout-datasets/architecture.md
- [Ray Train](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/train/user-guides/persistent-storage.html): S3 custom endpoint. Configure Ray checkpoint storage: `storage_path='s3://<bucket>/<path>?endpoint_override=https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com'`, or set `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3` and use a plain `s3://` path ([setup guide](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/train/user-guides/persistent-storage.html#s3-compatible-storage-backblaze-b2-minio-etc)). Architectures: architectures/policy-training-registry/architecture.md
- [MLflow](https://mlflow.org/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Native `b2://<bucket>@s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com/<path>` artifact URI ([setup guide](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/artifact-store/#backblaze-b2)). Architectures: architectures/policy-training-registry/architecture.md
- [Weights & Biases (reference artifacts)](https://wandb.ai/): S3 custom endpoint. Set `AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com` and log `s3://` references ([setup guide](https://docs.coreweave.com/guides/artifacts/track-external-files)). Architectures: architectures/policy-training-registry/architecture.md
- [ClearML](https://clear.ml/): S3 custom endpoint. Add an sdk.aws.s3.credentials entry with `host: 's3.<region>.backblazeb2.com:443'` and `secure: true` (the port is required) ([setup guide](https://clear.ml/docs/latest/docs/integrations/storage/)). Architectures: architectures/policy-training-registry/architecture.md
- [KISS-ICP](https://github.com/PRBonn/kiss-icp): S3 sync tool. kiss_icp_pipeline writes poses (.npy, KITTI, TUM), config, and logs to a local results directory; sync each session's results to `trajectories/<session_id>/` with rclone or s5cmd; the KISS-ICP LiDAR Archive sample does the same with boto3 and presigned URLs ([setup guide](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/kiss-icp-lidar-archive/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)). Architectures: architectures/mapping-session-archive/architecture.md
- [Open3D](https://www.open3d.org/): S3 sync tool. Open3D reads and writes PLY and PCD on local paths (`o3d.io.read_point_cloud`, `write_point_cloud`); copy scans down and sync job outputs to `jobs/<id>/` with rclone or s5cmd; the Open3D Point Cloud Pipeline sample does the same with the S3 API ([setup guide](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/open3d-point-cloud-pipeline/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)). Architectures: architectures/mapping-session-archive/architecture.md

## Sample applications: closest workflow matches

- [Rosbag2 Cloud Offload](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/rosbag2-cloud-offload): Presigned-PUT offload of closed rosbag2 splits, HEAD-confirmed local deletes, a Parquet session catalog, and ros2 bag play replay from presigned GETs.
- [LeRobot B2 Streaming](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lerobot-b2-streaming): LeRobot v3 teleop datasets on B2 streamed to training workers with ranged GETs planned from the meta/episodes index.
- [MuJoCo Rollout Dataset](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/mujoco-rollout-dataset): MuJoCo Playground rollouts written to B2 as per-episode MP4, state/action/reward arrays, and summary JSON.
- [KISS-ICP LiDAR Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/kiss-icp-lidar-archive): KISS-ICP odometry over LiDAR scans with scans, poses, .ply maps, and trajectories archived per session on B2.
- [Open3D Point Cloud Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/open3d-point-cloud-pipeline): Downsampling, registration, meshing, and rendering of point clouds stored on B2, with JSON job manifests.

## Sample applications: operational building blocks

- [Roboflow Inference Frame Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/roboflow-inference-frame-archive): Edge-triggered capture that archives only flagged frames, prediction JSON, and Parquet roll-ups to B2.
- [DuckDB Query In Place](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/duckdb-query-in-place): SQL over Parquet, CSV, and JSON on B2 with DuckDB httpfs, materializing results back to B2.
- [B2 Event Broker](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-event-broker): Fan-out of B2 Event Notifications to multiple subscribers.
- [WebDataset Streaming PyTorch Training](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/webdataset-streaming-pytorch-training): WebDataset tar shards streamed from B2 into a PyTorch IterableDataset, split by worker and node.
- [Ray Train/Tune checkpoints notebook](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/notebooks/tree/main/ray-train-tune-checkpoints): Ray Train and Tune checkpoints written to B2 persistent storage.
- [HF Cache Sync](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/hf-cache-sync): Shared Hugging Face hub cache on B2 so trainers, CI, and robots pull base models once.
- [Mountpoint for S3 CSI driver with B2](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-integration-mountpoint-csi): Read-mostly B2 bucket mounts in Kubernetes pods for jobs that expect file paths.

## Sample applications: domain resources
